problem: The owned phased crossing bypassed the normal one-entry-per-WALK cohort. Two opposing people could enter the same strip and their observed first-stage tracker paths could swap.

repair.registeredAt: Actual verified curb arrival, before the five-wall-second presentation dwell. Retried idempotently at continue. No native task is sent by queueing.
repair.ownership: Request is held only by a current phased lease at the real verified curb; owner, episode epoch, controller generation, native agent and timeline are checked.
repair.admission: The same (cycleIndex, phaseIndex, signalGroup) cohort as normal CrossWalk commands. Actual full native path, lateral band, applied light phase, vehicle phase, WALK and clearance remain required.
repair.earlierNormalCrossing: Never canceled or interrupted. A real same-group person still in a crossing keeps the owned walker at its curb.
repair.consumption: Only after a valid native movement task is accepted. Rejected navigation consumes no cohort. Cancellation after accepted entry leaves that current cohort consumed, as for normal movement.
repair.planning: A consumed current WALK reports the next real usable cohort to the existing once-latched capped signal budget. No wall cap or deadline rule changed.
repair.legacy: Non-Expo phased behavior is preserved. No normal signal table, actor program, analytics geometry, tracking threshold or identity alias changed.

validation.meaningfulOrderTest: Request queues on red; the ordinary people update executes before the scenario continuation at the next WALK, remains at its curb, then the owned valid native task consumes that exact cohort.
validation.harnessNote: A combined test_episode*.py discovery imports two controller test modules into one shared public registry, so its export-function identity assertion failed. Each episode module was then run separately and passed. This import-fixture collision is preserved as a harness limit, not counted as a pass.

liveAcceptanceRequired: Fresh people/controller and scenario source load by root
Actual queued request at native curb before WALK
No simultaneous opposing owned/normal strip entry
Independent same-ID camera far-side exit; no fabricated completion
